text: 26 How is the weather? And how is the day? Weather is changing day by day. We are enjoying everyday. Sometimes it’s sunny. Sometimes it’s cloudy. Sometimes it’s rainy. Sometimes it’s foggy. Sometimes it’s thundering. That keeps me wondering. Sometimes it’s cool. But don’t miss the school. 2. Read and write. 3. List the words that end with letter ‘y’. sunny how weather changing cloudy enjoying rainy thundering foggy cool miss wondering Weather 2.5 1. Listen and sing. For the Teacher : • Encourage the children to ask questions based on this poem.
